subject: philosophy
topicName: Epistemology, Moral Philosophy and Metaphysics of Mind

steps.title: Justified True Belief (JTB)
steps.body: The classical tripartite definition of propositional knowledge: S knows that p iff p is true, S believes that p, and S is justified in believing p.

steps.title: Substance Dualism
steps.body: Descartes' metaphysical thesis that mind and body are two distinct fundamental substances: thinking non-extended res cogitans and extended physical res extensa.
